concerns.text: T002 implements `is_rare AND is_semantically_distinct` but spec.md FR-012 defines rare events as ONLY '≤5 occurrences.' This creates two incompatible definitions. Either update FR-012 to include semantic distinctness, or remove the semantic gate from T002.

Threshold mismatch: spec.md FR-009 says 'fewer than 30 events,' plan.md Phase 4.3 says '< 50 events,' tasks.md T007 says '< 50 events.' Reconcile to a single authoritative threshold in spec.md, then update plan and tasks.

spec.md FR-001 specifies grid search over λ ∈ {0.1, 0.2, …, 9.9} only, but plan.md Phase 3 and tasks.md T006 implement joint (α, β, λ) grid search (2,673 combinations). Spec does not authorize joint optimization of α and β. Clarify whether spec permits joint search or only λ alone.

spec.md FR-001 requires validation set of '50 queries,' but T005 function signature `create_validation_set(memory_nodes_parquet, num_queries=50, random_seed=42)` does not enforce this size in the task description. Confirm 50-query size is mandatory, or update spec.

spec.md SC-004 states short-term accuracy 'does not degrade by more than 5%' but does not specify baseline (Fixed Hierarchy? prior version?). T007 clarifies baseline as Fixed Hierarchy, but spec is silent. Add explicit baseline definition to spec.md SC-004.

T001 requires `code/requirements.txt` but does not state whether exact versions (e.g., `numpy==1.26.0`) or ranges (e.g., `numpy>=1.26`) are required. Constitution.md Principle I requires 'pinned' versions (typically exact). Clarify in T001 whether exact pinning is mandatory.

plan.md Phase 0.4 says 'cluster event embeddings by event label,' but T002 implements global k-means (k=10) on all embeddings, not per-label clustering. Clarify clustering strategy: per-event-label or global? Update plan or task to match.

constitution.md Principle VI requires 'CPU cycle counts,' but T007 records `psutil.Process().cpu_times().user` (CPU time in seconds), not cycle counts. CPU time and cycles are different units. Either update spec to ask for CPU time, or use a cycle profiler (PAPI, perf) and document methodology.

spec.md SC-006 requires flag message 'Insufficient rare-event data: analysis skipped' with threshold < 30, but T007 uses message 'Insufficient rare-event data (n < 50): analysis skipped' with threshold 50. Update one or both to use consistent threshold and exact message text.

spec.md US-1 acceptance scenario 1 requires 'comparative accuracy report showing Top-1 accuracy for events >14 days,' but T005/T006 validation set has no age stratification mentioned. If validation set lacks >14-day events, grid search may optimize for wrong distribution. Clarify whether validation set must include >14-day events.
T009 is labeled '[P2]' but implements Phase 5 (reporting). Relabel as '[P3]' to match phase structure, or confirm phase numbering is intentionally different from plan.md.

T001 creates `specs/001-semantic-decay-retrieval/quickstart.md` but spec.md Assumptions do not mention quickstart documentation as a requirement. This is a minor scope addition; confirm it is intentional or remove from T001.
